lines.t: What kind of tour do you recommend for Saturday?
The city walking tour. It starts at the museum.
What time does it start, and how long does it take?
At nine. It takes about two hours, including a café stop.
Ten dollars per person. Food and drinks cost extra.
How far is the museum from this hotel?
About one kilometer. You can walk there in fifteen minutes.
Can you show me how to book the tour?
Of course. Choose Saturday on this page, then enter your name.
